title: Mary, the mother of Jesus
intro: Catholics honor Mary as the mother of God's Son, the first disciple and a model of faith. Scripture shows her highly favored by God, and she points always to Jesus.
phrasings: why do Catholics pray to Mary
what does the Bible say about Mary
is Mary the mother of God

title: The saints and intercession
intro: The saints are those already with God, and the Church believes they pray for us just as friends on earth pray for one another, since the communion of saints is not broken by death.
phrasings: why do Catholics pray to saints
what does the Bible say about saints
are saints in heaven praying for us

title: The Eucharist and Holy Communion
intro: At the Last Supper Jesus gave his Body and Blood, and the Church believes the Eucharist is truly Christ present under the appearance of bread and wine, the source and summit of Christian life.
phrasings: is communion really the body of Christ
what does the Bible say about the Eucharist

title: Going to Mass and keeping Sunday
intro: Christians gather on the Lord's Day to hear his Word and celebrate the Eucharist, as the first believers did.
phrasings: do I have to go to Mass
what does the Bible say about going to church
is it a sin to miss Mass

title: Purgatory
intro: The Church teaches that those who die in God's friendship but still need purification are cleansed before entering heaven, and that our prayers can help them.

title: Peter and the Church's authority
intro: Jesus built his Church on Peter and gave him the keys of the kingdom, the biblical root of the Church's belief in the papacy.
phrasings: why do Catholics have a pope
what does the Bible say about Peter

title: The Rosary and devotions
intro: The Rosary is a prayer that meditates on the life of Christ through the eyes of Mary, using Scripture-based prayers.

title: Catholic and Protestant differences
intro: Catholics and other Christians share faith in Christ and the Bible, but differ on matters such as Church authority, Tradition, the sacraments and the canon of Scripture.

title: The seven sacraments
intro: The sacraments are signs instituted by Christ that give us grace: Baptism, Confirmation, Eucharist, Reconciliation, Anointing of the Sick, Holy Orders and Matrimony.

title: Angels and guardian angels
intro: Angels are spiritual beings who serve God and watch over us; the Church teaches that each person has a guardian angel.
phrasings: what does the Bible say about angels

title: Demons and spiritual warfare
intro: Scripture teaches that evil spirits are real but defeated by Christ, and that we resist them with prayer, the sacraments and faith.
phrasings: what does the Bible say about demons

title: The end times and the Second Coming
intro: Jesus promised to return in glory; the Church is told to watch and be ready rather than try to predict the day.
phrasings: what does the Bible say about the end times
signs of the end of the world

title: Creation and evolution
intro: The Bible teaches truths about who made the world and why, not a science textbook; the Church holds that faith and reason, properly understood, do not contradict each other.
phrasings: what does Genesis say about creation

title: The Ten Commandments
intro: The Ten Commandments are God's gift of a path of love for him and for neighbor, and Jesus came to fulfill them.

title: The Beatitudes and the Sermon on the Mount
intro: In the Beatitudes Jesus describes the path to true happiness and the character of his disciples.
phrasings: blessed are the poor in spirit

title: Who wrote the Bible and which books belong?
intro: The Bible is a library of 73 books in the Catholic canon, written by human authors under God's inspiration and recognized by the Church.
phrasings: why does the Catholic Bible have more books
how was the Bible put together

title: How to read the Bible
intro: Read Scripture prayerfully and regularly, in the light of the Church, beginning with the Gospels and Psalms.
phrasings: where should I start reading the Bible
how to read the Bible daily

title: Old Testament laws and violence
intro: The Old Testament shows God gradually forming his people; its laws and difficult passages are read in the light of Christ, who fulfills them.
phrasings: why is the Old Testament violent
do Old Testament laws still apply

title: David and Goliath
intro: A young shepherd trusts God and defeats a giant, showing that victory belongs to the Lord.
phrasings: how did David defeat the giant

title: Noah and the flood
intro: Noah's faithfulness saved his family, and God's covenant promised never to destroy the earth again by flood.
phrasings: why did God flood the earth
how many animals on the ark

title: Moses and the Exodus
intro: God frees his people from slavery in Egypt through Moses, and leads them to the promised land.

title: The Prodigal Son
intro: Jesus' parable of a loving father who welcomes home his wayward son reveals the heart of God's mercy.

title: The Good Samaritan
intro: Jesus answers "who is my neighbor?" with a story of unexpected compassion across social divides.

title: Jonah and God's mercy
intro: Jonah's flight from God and his time in the great fish teach that God's mercy reaches even those we wish to condemn.
phrasings: story of Jonah and the whale

title: The story of Job
intro: Job loses everything yet clings to God, and the book teaches that faith can endure without easy answers.

title: Psalms for every moment
intro: The Psalms give words to every human emotion, and the Church prays them daily.
